title_sq: Te Prokuroria Te Mine Peza Shesim Garazhd Me 2 Vende Parkim
description_sq:
Ne nje nga zonat me te mira te Tiranes, tek Mine Peza perball prokurorise se Tiranes shesim garazhd te mbyllur me qepen me dy vende parkimi. 
Garazhdi ndodhet ne nje pallat te ri ne katin -1. 
Ka nje siperfaqe prej 35 m2 neto. 
Pozicioni ne te cilen ndodhet eshte i kerkuar pasi nuk ka shume vende parkiumi .
Disponon certifikate te rregullt pronesie. 
Per me shume informacion apo nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni.
title_en: At the Prosecutor's Office in Peza, Garage with 2 Parking Spaces for Sale
description_en: In one of the best areas of Tirana, at Mine Peza in front of the prosecutor's office of Tirana, we are selling a closed garage with two parking spaces. The garage is located in a new building on the -1st floor. It has a surface of 35 m2 net. The position in which it is located is in demand as there are not many parking spaces. It has regular ownership certificates. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me.
